newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, PT star of session.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, PT star of session.

text.p: 1725 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher amid strong turnover in Portugal Telecom, which hit another all-time high on optimism ahead of its 1996 results announcement at 0900 GMT on Wednesday.
* Other shares dragged higher by the enthusiastic buying of Portuguese stocks included pulp group Portucel Industrial, cement group Semapa and retail group Sonae Investimentos.

* PT shares hit an all-time high of 6,580 escudos before closing at 6,545, up 147, in turnover of 409,240. Operators said investors were expecting PT's 1996 net consolidated profit to reach 53 billion escudos, compared with an average of analysts' forecasts around 52 billion.

* Shares in insurer Mundial Confianca dropped sharply after the company's 1996 results fell short of the overly optimistic expectations of some investors, dealers said. Mundial Confianca shares hit a low of 2,000 escudos, down 8.5 percent from yesterday's close, before clawing back to close at 2,050 escudos, down 120, in turnover of 138,286.
* "The Lisbon market will be dictated by the foreign trend and by PT," one operator said.
